reviews.title: Learning the hard way about an esim
reviews.body:
I was on holiday and needed roaming data as the hotel wifi was poor. I bought some add on data but it was much cheaper to use an esim - something I had never used before in all of my 71 years. Needless to say that it didn't work so I tried again, once more apparently unsuccessfully. Faced with this I bought more roaming data and completed the holiday.
It transpires that I should have downloaded the esim but I didn't so I noticed I had been charged for both transactions when I looked at my bank statement after returning home.
I tried standard Lebara customer services as they've always been helpful and they put me on to their separate travel section. After a few minutes of explanation and checking the refund for the esim's I never used is now on it's way back to my account. Excellent service again

reviews.title: The installation process very bad
reviews.body:
The installation process through the app and website was terrible. The Lebara Travel app was completely unusable—stuck on a loading loop and failing to fetch my plan details. To make matters worse, the website's step-by-step setup guide was completely unhelpful and didn't work as advertised. Instead of giving a clear, standard QR code or manual activation code, it forced me into a broken app loop. Very disappointing and frustrating technical experience.

On a positive note phenomenal online live chat agent Alli who helped me out. Once I reached out via chat, the agent was quick, patient, and extremely helpful. He completely bypassed the broken app process and sent me the direct link to manually install the eSIM profile directly onto my phone settings within minutes. Excellent 5-star customer service from him—he turned a very stressful setup into a success!
